book.title: Little Doodles for Big Feelings
book.description: In Little Doodles for Big Feelings, Liz brings together fan-favorite drawings alongside never-before-seen art, paired with uplifting reminders of how loved and important we all are. Liz and her whimsical characters offer gentle wisdom about self-love, connection, and finding joy in everyday moments. Pocket-sized and full of heart, this book is the perfect pick-me-up for anyone who needs a little extra positivity.

brand.headline: Let's make something together
brand.intro: I make illustrated stories and influencer-style videos for brands and organizations. Most of my work is about mental health, but I also love projects around art, tech, community spaces, and events.
brand.rep_text: Brand partnerships are handled by my management team.

about.body:
I'm an artist and illustrator based in Philly. I draw funny little characters going through very real feelings, and somehow a lot of you feel them too.

You can find my prints on Etsy, my book wherever books are sold, and me at markets around the city. Thanks so much for stopping by!
